h1: Had Sai Resort Chumphon — A Simple Resort Right on Sai Ri Beach You Can Walk to the Sea From
intro: If the goal of your trip is to wake up and walk a few steps onto Sai Ri Beach without spending much, Had Sai Resort is one option whose location delivers exactly that. This simple resort of around 33 rooms sits right on Sai Ri Beach, near the Khao Chao Mueang viewpoint, with a restaurant, bike rental and a pet-friendly policy. The main draw is the beachfront setting and the low price — though, to be honest, the room condition and value are points guests disagree on. Rooms start from about THB 1,200/night. Score 6.4 from real guest reviews.

body.html: Had Sai Resort is a small beachfront resort of around 33 rooms, set in the Hat Sai Ri sub-district, right on Chumphon's Sai Ri Beach. What makes people choose it is a location you can genuinely walk to the sea from — no need to drive anywhere. Rooms come as deluxe rooms, sea-view rooms and bungalows, decorated in a plain, no-frills way that prioritises being functional and comfortable at a budget price.

What the resort does well is its beachfront position and an approachable price. Sai Ri is one of Chumphon's quieter beaches, good for an early-morning walk along the shore or watching the light fade. On site there's a restaurant, bikes for rent to ride along the beach, plus massage, laundry and free parking. Another plus for travellers with pets: the resort allows them (best to confirm in advance when you book).
"The upside is you walk a few steps and you're on the beach. In the morning you can stroll the quiet shoreline, and the price isn't high — good for anyone who wants to sleep by the sea on a budget."

But to be straight about it — reviews here are genuinely mixed, split between fans and the disappointed. The less impressed tend to mention rooms that look older and plainer than expected, some rooms without a full sea view, and value that, in peak season, a few guests felt didn't quite balance out. Some older reviews note no breakfast provided and minimal in-room amenities, so if you book, check clearly what the package includes before deciding.

For the surroundings, the resort sits about 670 m from the Khao Chao Mueang viewpoint, one of the prettier sea views in the Sai Ri Beach area. It's around 23 km from Chumphon railway station and a fair drive from the town centre. The area is quiet, with few places open at night, so having your own car or a rented motorbike makes it much easier to head out for food or to reach other parts of Chumphon.

In short, Had Sai Resort suits travellers who weight sleeping right on Sai Ri Beach on a budget over newness or a full slate of facilities. If you're here for a short stay focused on the beach and the Khao Chao Mueang view, and you're not fussed about plain rooms, it offers a beachfront location that's hard to find at this price. But if you expect crisp, new rooms, a generous breakfast, or a resort with a pool and activities laid on, compare carefully with the other options in this roundup first — this place leans on simplicity and location above all.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Had Sai Resort Chumphon

faq.q: Where is Had Sai Resort · is it on the beach?
faq.a: It's at 99/6-7 Moo 7, Hat Sai Ri, Chumphon, right on Sai Ri Beach. You can walk a few steps to the sea. It's about 670 m from the Khao Chao Mueang viewpoint, roughly 23 km from Chumphon railway station, and around a 20-minute drive from the town centre.

faq.q: What's the starting price · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from about THB 1,200/night for a deluxe room. There are also sea-view rooms, bungalows and family rooms (roughly THB 1,600–2,400). Rates vary by season and package, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Had Sai Resort allow pets?
faq.a: Yes — the resort allows pets. It's best to confirm the conditions with the property in advance when you book.

faq.q: Who is Had Sai Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want to sleep right on Sai Ri Beach on a budget, focused on the beachfront setting and shoreline walks, and not fussed about plain rooms. If you want newer rooms, a pool or a generous breakfast, another option in this roundup may suit you better.

faq.q: What facilities does the resort have?
faq.a: There's a restaurant, bike rental, massage, laundry and free parking. There's no pool. The main strength is the beachfront location, with easy access to Sai Ri Beach and the Khao Chao Mueang viewpoint.

faq.q: What are the reviews like · should I book?
faq.a: Reviews are fairly mixed — fans like the beachfront location and price, while the disappointed tend to mention plain, worn rooms and peak-season value. If you prioritise a beachfront stay on a budget you can book, but check the latest room photos and breakfast terms before confirming.
